svg.text: Fig. 8 | Spatial-molecular systems architecture of spaceflight tropism and mechanotransduction.
Multiscale integration of subcellular mechanoperception, single-cell tissue activation (inflorescence stem_9 & root columella), and functional pathway cross-talk in Arabidopsis thaliana.
Plant statocyte & elongating vascular cambium site
• H⁺ extrusion by AHA1/2 lowers apoplast pH to ~4.8
• Low pH activates expansins (EXPA1/8) & XTH xyloglucanases
Key DEGs: XTH22 (+0.84 log₂FC, padj=1e-8) · EXPA1 (+0.62)
• RBOHD generates O₂•⁻ → CSD1 dismutates to H₂O₂
• Peroxidases regulate wall cross-linking & microgravity stress
Key DEGs: PRXIIB (+1.22 log₂FC) · CSD1 (+0.78) · CAT2 (-0.43)
• Cytosolic Ca²⁺ transients direct RABA1A/ARF1A1C polar targeting
• MPK3 (+0.88 log₂FC) coordinates the downstream stress cascade
ARF19 / ARF7 activate SAUR expansion genes
Heat Shock Factors (HSFs) trigger chaperone network
MPK3 / MPK6 MAP kinase regulatory pathway
• MDH1 (+0.63 log₂FC) Malate dehydrogenase TCA cycle
Single-cell deconvolution across Salk developmental atlas clusters (GSE226097)
Key Insight: Inflorescence stem vascular cambium (stem_9) mounts peak cell-wall loosening
Coupled with root tip columella Ca²⁺ signaling, defining the primary axis of microgravity gravitropic remodeling.
Sequential cascade: physical microgravity perception to cellular stress adaptation
Amyloplasts lose buoyant weight; freely float in statocytes
Membrane tension shifts induce repetitive cytosolic Ca²⁺ pulses
RABA1A/ARF1A1C endosomes redirect PIN2/3/7 to lateral flanks
Auxin accumulates in stem cambium (stem_9) & root stele
PM H⁺-ATPase pumping activates XTH22 & EXPA1 expansins
Apoplastic ROS (RBOHD) mitigated by HSP70 & PRXIIB chaperones
6 core functional hubs with spaceflight DEG counts and regulatory cross-talk
